PC: Perform airway assessment—recognize airway compromise and perform intubation.
Perform appropriate primary and secondary survey. Obtain information from ancillary sources, such as EMS. Recognize smoke inhalation.
Smoke inhalation recognized—CO concentration and lactate sent
CN poisoning recognized—treat with hydroxocobalamin, or if not available, sodium thiosufate. If treating with sodium thiosulfate, consider sodium nitrite and amyl nitrite.
MK: Recognize that the patient is not responding to initial interventions. Perform an assessment for complications of smoke inhalation (trauma, CO poisoning).
